objective: Modernise the final Capstone presentation layer into an accessible, responsive, Microsoft Fluent-inspired business experience without changing the working AI, RAG, PBIP, PDF or security architecture.
requirements: APBRA-137 Final Capstone UX & Product Experience Modernisation
acceptance_criteria: The business workflow and administration areas use a coherent Microsoft Fluent-inspired enterprise presentation that is accessible, responsive and scenario-neutral.
Business-facing labels and progressive disclosure make the workflow understandable while retaining technical evidence for inspection.
Successful generation presents the existing Power BI project and fixed-name PDF deployment guide as polished downloadable artefacts.
Existing GPT-4.1, schema ingestion, governed RAG, Report Design, guardrail, PBIP, validation, PDF and security behaviour remains unchanged.
verification_required: Hosted secret scan and separate review
Manual visual inspection of major business and administration states
out_of_scope: Backend, dependency, configuration or data changes
Changes to prompts, structured AI contracts, schema parsing, RAG, governed knowledge, guardrails, PBIP compilation, deterministic validation, PDF generation or security
New product functionality, fake controls or unsupported actions
escalate_when: Source contradiction or expanded product scope
A required implementation path is outside the exact allowlist
The presentation change requires a dependency, backend or functional architecture change
Tests, build, accessibility checks, visual verification or secret scanning are unavailable
actual_authenticated_actor: Codex implementation execution via haseebulhaque authenticated GitHub connection
dependencies: Merged APBRA-76 deployment guide implementation and existing successful Capstone application architecture.
This governance registration must merge before the separate APBRA-137 presentation implementation begins.
